lines.zh: 两头羊驼跟得稳，我放心
lines.en: Both llamas keep pace, that puts me at ease.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过三次，每次都不一样
lines.en: I walked this road three times, never the same.
While the caravan moves, the wind keeps blowing.

lines.zh: 我的毯子卷在羊驼背上
lines.en: My blankets ride rolled up on the llama's back.

lines.zh: 前面有炊烟，今晚有生意
lines.en: Smoke ahead means business tonight.

lines.zh: 别走太快，羊驼驮着重物
lines.en: Slow down, the llamas carry heavy loads.

lines.zh: 我从很远的地方来，还要更远
lines.en: I come from far away and go farther still.
Follow the river, water makes the road clear.
I have worn out three pairs of boots.

lines.zh: 天边的云在动，该赶路了
lines.en: Clouds are moving at the horizon, time to go.

lines.zh: 村庄的钟声，是最好的路标
lines.en: A village bell is the finest signpost.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边算今天赚的
lines.en: I count today's earnings while I walk.

lines.zh: 这条小径的草被踩平了
lines.en: Someone has flattened the grass on this trail.

lines.zh: 两头羊驼一前一后，我走中间
lines.en: Two llamas front and back, I walk between.

lines.zh: 我的货还剩半箱，够本了
lines.en: Half a crate of goods left, I broke even.

lines.zh: 羊驼在嚼草，我就歇一会
lines.en: The llamas are chewing grass, so I rest.
The wind here is drier than back home.

lines.zh: 我数了数，还差三颗绿宝石
lines.en: I counted, still three emeralds short.
The stall is open, nobody comes.

lines.zh: 路走多了，脚底板会记路
lines.en: Walk enough and your feet remember the road.

lines.zh: 我这些稀奇货，本地买不到
lines.en: My curious wares cannot be bought locally.
The lead rope loosened, I must tie it again.

lines.zh: 今晚睡在树下，不搭帐篷
lines.en: Tonight I sleep under a tree, no tent.

lines.zh: 有人问我家在哪，我说不上
lines.en: When asked where home is, I cannot say.

lines.zh: 羊驼打了个喷嚏，喷我一身
lines.en: A llama sneezed and sprayed my coat.
My scale was handed down from my father.

lines.zh: 这条路上没有第二个人
lines.en: There is no second person on this road.

lines.zh: 我把最好的货藏在箱底
lines.en: I keep my best goods at the bottom of the crate.
Customer, would you like to see the goods?

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在往我的箱子上瞟
lines.en: Your eyes keep sliding toward my crate.

lines.zh: 我等了一整天，就等你这样
lines.en: I waited all day for someone like you.
You have enough coin for one item.

lines.zh: 我一眼看出你没见过这些
lines.en: I can tell at a glance you have never seen these.
No rush, look first, then we haggle.
Is your village far from here?

lines.zh: 我认识你这双靴子的手艺
lines.en: I know the hand that made those boots.

lines.zh: 你是这附近第一个问价的
lines.en: You are the first here to ask a price.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，走到哪都新鲜
lines.en: My face is new wherever I arrive.

lines.zh: 你手里那把东西，我不收
lines.en: That thing in your hand, I will not buy.
Come closer, my ears are not what they were.
Customer, goods do not wait for anyone.
You look like someone who knows quality.

lines.zh: 你腰上那把剑，先放下来。
lines.en: Set that sword at your hip down first.

lines.zh: 我看你手上的茧，是干活的。
lines.en: The calluses on your hands; you do real work.
My crate has been knocked open.
Stop hitting, I carry little money.

lines.zh: 这一下，今天的买卖白做
lines.en: That hit erased today's profit.
My ribs are frailer than my crate.
I have taken no beating the whole journey.
Blood is dripping onto my blanket.
You have bent my scale out of true.
I should have left this place sooner.
A trader should not take such a blow.
I will remember your face.
At that price I need to think.
Hold the emerald a little higher.
This rare thing will not go for nothing.
There is better still in my crate.
At that number I lose money.

lines.zh: 我对好东西也没什么抵抗力
lines.en: Even I cannot resist a fine piece.
That gem has a decent color to it.

lines.zh: 你再加一点，我们就成交
lines.en: Add a little more and we have a deal.

lines.zh: 我心动了，但生意是生意
lines.en: I am tempted, but business is business.
Do not test me with a price like that.
Careful, the llamas are right behind me.
Bump me and the lead ropes tangle.
Make way, I am carrying cargo.
My crate cannot take a knock.
The path is narrow, you go first.
You are standing on my blanket.
The llamas kick, step back.
I have not bumped anyone all journey.
Steady, dropped goods must be paid for.
Let me pass, a caravan waits for no one.
My companions are these two llamas.
Wherever I stop is fine, I have no home.

lines.zh: 路上没人等我，也习惯了
lines.en: Nobody waits on the road, I am used to it.
With company the road feels shorter.

lines.zh: 我把最后一块干粮分给他
lines.en: I split my last ration with him.
People in a caravan come and go.

lines.zh: 我这一生只认路，不认人
lines.en: All my life I know roads, not people.
Do not ask me that, the road matters more.

lines.zh: 有人结伴，我就不算独行
lines.en: With a companion I am not walking alone.

lines.zh: 我给她带过一块远方的布
lines.en: I once brought her cloth from far away.

lines.zh: 这枚硬币滚到我脚边了
lines.en: This coin rolled right to my feet.
I pick it up to check the quality.
Dropped things I gather as I pass.

lines.zh: 一块布，正好补我的毯子
lines.en: A scrap of cloth, just right for my blanket.

lines.zh: 谁丢的种子，我替他留着
lines.en: Someone's seed, I will keep it for them.

lines.zh: 我捡了半路，捡出一笔小财
lines.en: Half a road of picking added up nicely.
This one on the ground is not my stock.
Pick things fast, the llamas will not wait.

lines.zh: 这个我出两个绿宝石收
lines.en: I will buy this one for two emeralds.
Whatever falls by the road counts as toll.
The bushes over there are moving.
Someone is following my caravan.

lines.zh: 我看见树林里有个影子
lines.en: I saw a shape inside the treeline.
Bad news, that is an illager banner.

lines.zh: 羊驼停住了，它们先察觉
lines.en: The llamas stopped, they sensed it first.
Nobody should be lying in wait here.
I have closed the lid of my crate.
The road ahead has been blocked.
Let me first see who it is.
I suspect this trip ends here.
I am only a seller of goods.
If you want money, take the crate.
Stay back, I will call for help.
I know that outfit you wear.
At my age I cannot run far.

lines.zh: 你挡住我做生意的路了
lines.en: You are blocking my way to trade.
I step back, you step back too.
A caravan seeks no trouble and fears none.

lines.zh: 我的羊驼会记住你的味道
lines.en: My llamas will remember your scent.
If you want something, say it plainly.
I will hit you with my scale beam.
That blow is worth one emerald.
I rarely fight, but I aim well.
Do not make a trader use his hands.
I swing the crate straight at you.
This punch is for my llamas.
I am old, but my hands are steady.
Now you owe me for that.
After this I pack the stall and leave.
Step back and I stop swinging.
I have come from a very long road.

lines.zh: 两头羊驼，一箱货，我到了
lines.en: Two llamas, one crate, and here I am.
Does anyone need something unusual?
I am resting in this village for now.
I set out before the sky turned pale.

lines.zh: 我带着货，从雨里走出来
lines.en: I walked out of the rain with my wares.

lines.zh: 这里的人不认得我的脸
lines.en: The people here do not know my face.

lines.zh: 绳子系好了，摊子也支好
lines.en: Ropes tied, stall propped, all ready.

lines.zh: 商队到站，先找个落脚处
lines.en: Caravan arrived, first find a place to rest.
I heard someone call to see the goods.
My blanket has caught fire.
In that fall the crate landed first.
My goods sank, and so am I.
My goods, all of them gone.
Who looses arrows from the dark?
I do not touch such unwholesome things.
I sell food and go hungry myself.
The llamas are crying out in fear.
The road ends here, and below is nothing.
